programmes.d: On the trail, Bowie rescues a sole surviving baby from a burning covered wagon. When the local sheriff refuses to get involved, a tavern owner agrees to watch the baby.
Bowie tracks a seemingly delusional young bride who is kidnapped following her wedding. He learns that she may have been hypnotized, so he sets a trap for the suspected hypnotist.
Cisco and Pancho help a young couple elope.
After Diablo and Loco are stolen, Cisco and Pancho deal with a man who is protecting his killer son.
Cisco and Pancho help a young woman who has been swindled by a man with a mean sense of humor. Pancho adopts a pet raven he names Señor Cortez.
Lucas tries to dissuade a latter-day knight from rushing into battle.
Abe Lincoln's claim that he's the Great Emancipator amuses everyone except Matt Yordy.
Josh and Jason are on the trail of a karate expert accused of killing his employer.

Randall learns "hate comes high" in a town whose people have hired a trio of killers to murder their fellow resident Randy Holleran, a sniveling drunkard whom Josh can't stand but has promised his father to protect.
Annie and Tagg meet Tim Lafferty, a strange old Irishman who claims to be searching for treasure with the help of leprechauns who followed him to America from the Auld Country.
A young doctor returns to Diablo. Unknown to his father, the son fell in with bad company while at school and owes a crooked gambler a large sum of money.

While rummaging through an old trunk, Tagg and his friend Johnny Ward, the son of a murdered lawman, find evidence that they believe proves his uncle is an ex-convict and may be part of the outlaw gang who recently robbed Diablo's bank.
The federal government tells Choctaw tribes to move from Mississippi to Arkansas, but one tribe refuses because the chief's son is sick.
While visiting Tennessee, local politicians enlist Bowie's help in defeating Davy Crockett for Congress. Bowie agrees to help them but then refuses their smear tactics.

Josh embarks on a mission of mercy when he pleads with the parents of a boy with appendicitis to let the doctor operate.
Josh reluctantly accepts an offbeat assignment: finding a beautiful bride for his bashful buddy Charlie, the homeliest and loneliest man in the West.
The government employs Randall to portray an escaped prisoner in order to trick his cellmate into leading authorities to the $50,000 he stole and stashed away in a secret location.
Randall finds his prey in the hands of a lynch mob wiping out his bounty.
Who needs enemies with friends like the residents of Rogue City, who celebrate Randall for bringing in notorious killer Jumbo Kane.
Randall is rooked out of his bounty by crafty criminal Hunt Willis and his accomplice.

Against better judgment after losing a quick draw contest and bet, Josh serves as a guide for a dandified East Coast gun salesman who comes west to retrieve and replace a defective gun he sold to notorious outlaw Curly Bill Brocius.
On the trail of a Cavalry deserter and the horses he stole, Josh rides into a town ruled as the private fiefdom of its autocratic, psychopathic marshal who is holding the horses and deserter.
Hired by a father to bring back the man who killed his son Josh is surprised when he doesn't get paid because he brought the man back alive.
Josh must bring a man back for murder.
Josh brings a wanted man into the Mesa City Sheriff, only to find he killed the sheriff's brother.
Josh is looking for a man who, while trying to rob a bank, is bitten by a rabid dog.
A man shoots his brother over ownership of their property and blames it on an Indian who reclaimed his horse the man found and stole.
Josh is captured by a corrupt deputy and is forced by the sheriff to work on a chain gang in a gold mine.
Randall is tracking an escape artist who is forced to distract a town, letting three guys rob the bank.
Josh plays detective when he signs on to help an amnesiac discover his identity.
After watching her father stabbed to death, a grieving daughter wants immediate justice rather than wait for the slower-moving wheels of justice.
Josh is determined to debunk the dire menace posed by a marauding monster that has smashed mining camps, decimated an Indian village, and has the Nugget City residents hiding behind locked doors.
Josh, down on his luck, hires out for $100/day to find a woman - one catch is she may be dead.
Josh brings in \\"Doc\\" Phillips hoping he can lure Clell Fanning out as he has an old score to settle with Clell.
Josh is arrested on a bogus horse-stealing charge.
To net a thousand-dollar reward and save a friend, Josh saves Tolliver Bender from hanging so he can testify in a nearby trial.
An attractive woman hires Josh for $1000 to clear her father on a false murder charge in a town that is not very welcoming to Josh.
Josh and Jason are hired to chase a killer who went to Mexico by his brother who is about to hang for a crime his brother committed.
Cal and Sam share a mining claim, but circumstances prevent them from keeping control of their millions.
A former outlaw takes the unenviable job of sheriff in a lawless town, and old habits die hard.
Rachel Barrett's act of kindness toward an injured Native leads to her family's capture.
An alcoholic tries to sober up long enough to save the lives of his friend and his niece.
